FADE¶

Applies a linear fade-in at the start of the PCM buffer and a linear fade-out at the end.

Arguments¶

Name

Type

Description

left

float

Duration (in seconds) of fade-in at the beginning.

right

float

Duration (in seconds) of fade-out at the end.

Input¶

Type

Description

s32v

PCM buffer.

Output¶

Type

Description

s32v

PCM buffer with fade applied.

Example¶

FADE 10.0 30.0
